claims_reviewed.claim: A Network Finance-advertised Finance Director CA (SA) | Distribution, Retail and Manufacturing role (PNet 4269935; ref NFR011175-MoD-1) was retrievable on 2026-10-07.
claims_reviewed.evidence: Direct PNet detail page identifies the role, reference and Network Finance advertiser, and displays Published: 1 week ago. Network Finance is the advertiser, not a verified hiring employer.

claims_reviewed.claim: The role stated scope is within the finance taxonomy and matches the preserved functional classification.
claims_reviewed.evidence: Finance Director reporting to the CEO; strategic finance, profitability, cash flow, FX/trade finance, imports/supply chain, manufacturing costing and inventory, financial controls and team leadership. CA(SA), 8–10 years in senior financial leadership, manufacturing/distribution/import-export, Syspro and treasury/trade-finance experience are stated.
claims_reviewed.decision: Classify as Finance Leadership, taxonomy node 6 / Group B; preserve the raw title and source wording.

claims_reviewed.claim: The role clears the R420,000 p.a. salary screen.
claims_reviewed.evidence: The direct Package & Remuneration section states R1,300,000–R1,500,000 annually; the annual lower bound is above R420,000 p.a.
claims_reviewed.decision: Uphold for provisional salary screening only; do not infer package composition.

claims_reviewed.evidence: The direct advert uses an anonymous client/sector description and names Network Finance as the advertiser; no end-employer name appears.
claims_reviewed.decision: Keep employer and client status unknown; do not infer from sector, title or location.

claims_reviewed.claim: The PNet advert is still accepted by the employer.
claims_reviewed.evidence: The page was retrievable and displayed Published: 1 week ago at retrieval on 2026-10-07; no employer-side confirmation or closing date was shown.
claims_reviewed.decision: Record as listed on PNet at retrieval only; employer-side acceptance remains unknown.

claims_reviewed.claim: The possible related listing/re-title is the same requisition.
claims_reviewed.evidence: Financial Manager: Manufacturing FMCG 4269944 (ref NFR011176-MoD-1) has similar manufacturing/finance scope, same agency and adjacent reference; possible related or re-title signal only. Different titles, pay ranges and duties do not confirm a common employer or requisition; keep separate.
claims_reviewed.decision: Keep all IDs separate; do not merge or identify a shared employer without recruiter/employer confirmation.

claims_reviewed.claim: This is a Boschendal or Laurium agreed-client opportunity.
claims_reviewed.evidence: No end-employer name or agreed-client relationship appears in the direct listing.
claims_reviewed.decision: Do not promote to agreed-client priority.

claims_upheld: A retrievable Network Finance PNet advert for Finance Director CA (SA) | Distribution, Retail and Manufacturing was observed on 2026-10-07.
The direct page displays R1,300,000–R1,500,000 annually, whose lower bound clears R420,000 p.a.
The page stated duties and requirements support the preserved finance-function classification.
claims_downgraded: PNet visibility and a recent relative publication age do not prove employer-side acceptance.
Network Finance is the agency advertiser, not a confirmed end employer.
Any relationship to other anonymous Network Finance ads remains a hypothesis, not a confirmed duplicate.
claims_removed: No end employer, hiring owner, company email, candidate, or personal contact detail is inferred from anonymous client language.
unknowns: End-employer identity, employer-side vacancy acceptance and client/agreed-client status are unresolved.
Package composition (base, CTC, bonus or variable pay) is unstated.
Potential related/re-title status requires recruiter or employer confirmation; retain distinct source IDs.
No employer stakeholder/company-email, target-company or candidate mapping is activated while the end employer remains unknown.
next_research_actions: Identify the hiring employer via reliable agency/employer-origin evidence and verify employer-side vacancy status and package composition.
Investigate the possible related/re-title ads without merging on title, sector, recruiter or location alone.
Do not begin stakeholder/company-email, target-company or candidate mapping until the employer is confirmed or high-confidence.
